description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Use when an agent asks what tokens just launched or got a new PancakeSwap/Uniswap/Aerodrome pool on BNB Chain or Base. Pool, DEX, token, quote, exact creation time, volume/liquidity since launch. Returns JSON new pools: pool, DEX, token, quote, creation time, and volume and liquidity since launch.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Chain whose new DEX pools to list. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: bsc. Allowed values: bsc, base.

hours.description: How many hours back to look. Format: a positive number. Example: 3. Omit for the server's current window.

limit.description: Maximum pools. Format: positive integer. Example: 50. Omit for the server's current cap.

name: meme_new_pools
title: New DEX pools on BNB Chain / Base ($0.005)
